text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... The riddle-solving game they had here
has already ended.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I hope we can have another fun experience
like that somewhere again.
choice_data_list: Then how about we venture a bit further out?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

It was a rare day off.
I decided to take her to some sightseeing spots and help make some wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so the sunset is the main highlight on this mountain!
Is our station coming up soon?

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next stop is the final stop. The final stop—
Please watch your step as you exit...’"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh? Last stop?
choice_data_list: Shoot, this is an express train!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waah! You're right!
The stations are whizzing past so fast!

We managed to reach our destination, but...
It's already past lunchtime.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Since the timing's so good, let's grab a late lunch! I'd love to try the local specialty here too, you know?"
choice_data_list: I know a delicious place, I'll show you the way!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Closed today to cheer on my favorite Umamusume."
Looks like the owner took the day off.

We continued sightseeing while trying to make up for lost time,
and finally reached the summit! ...However—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wah! What a beautiful night view!
choice_data_list: We were supposed to watch the sunset...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's save that for another time!
For now, let's just enjoy this moment♪
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah. At least a commemorative photo—
Y-Yeah. At least a commemorative photo—

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: Kikiii!

Just as I took out my phone to take a picture,
a monkey snatched it away—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness, Trainer's phone!
We have to get it back right away... Commander!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Understood! ...Wait right there, monkey!!

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: SCREEEEECH!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it really was an amazing day.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trains, closed shops, monkeys.
We managed to get your smartphone back, but... Captain, your suit got torn.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: ...Haah.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hehe, sorry about that.
An outing this unpredictable is just so refreshing...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Of course,
I had opportunities to visit many places for inspections, you know?
I had plenty of thrilling experiences too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still—an outing with this many surprises,
you couldn't pull it off even if you tried!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you're amazing, Trainer!
You really should hold your head high!♪
choice_data_list: I feel like I'm making you worry...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's really not the case, though.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, look at this!
I took a ton of fun pictures!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is the convenience store we stopped by when we missed lunch!
The selection really reflected the local flavor, so it was super educational...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This was on the road while chasing that little monkey.
There were no telephone poles or streetlights, so the starry sky looked so wide...
It felt really nice!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"This is all thanks to you bringing me here.
Every bit of it is a precious memory."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's not about what you do.
Isn't what you feel inside what really matters?

Her positive words and smile were a comfort...
but next time, I felt determined to do my best
for her sake.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly!
You're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yo, the blessed daimyo!
Make wa~y!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Unexpected laughter.
Is this not how it's done in Japan?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh well.
As long as it makes you smile.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I go out with you, I always seem to find something interesting.
Let's do this again next time!"
Hearing her offer warm words in such an upbeat tone made me want to give her a truly fun experience next time for sure.
